page.layout: One scan showing a closed book in a vellum binding, front board viewed from the front. No printed text on the page. Manuscript-style marks and a faint spine label at the left edge are not printed text.
page.notes: Scan shows the outside of a vellum-bound volume (cover), not a printed page. Visible: four or five laced-through tie sewing-holes along the left spine edge, faint ink marks on the spine label at the far left edge (partly cut off, unreadable), and some pencil-like strokes at upper right of the board. None of this is printed text, so the page is transcribed as empty.
